nbe534670f37.s: India's GST, recommended by the Vijay Kelkar Task Force, follows the dual model of which country?
nbe534670f37.x: India's GST follows the Canadian dual model; France is where the GST concept was first used.

n253758447af.s: Which of the following pairs about voting in the GST Council is correctly matched?
o: All States together – one-half of votes cast
Centre's vote – one-third of votes cast
Centre's vote – one-fourth of votes cast
n253758447af.x: Under Article 279A the Centre has one-third and the States together two-thirds of votes cast; decisions need a three-fourths weighted majority.

n939558d2a3c.s: Which of the following is one of the five petroleum products kept outside the current levy of GST?
n939558d2a3c.x: The five are crude oil, petrol, high-speed diesel, natural gas and aviation turbine fuel; lubricating oil is not among them.

nindian-economy-15-3.s: Under destination-based GST, revenue ultimately accrues to the jurisdiction where goods or services are:
nindian-economy-15-3.x: GST is destination-based, so revenue goes to the State where goods or services are consumed, not where they are produced.

n9f875074379.s: From 1 February 2026, the compensation-cess arrangement for tobacco was replaced by:
o: A special State GST on tobacco
A customs duty collected by the GST Council
A surcharge under the IGST Act
n9f875074379.x: Higher excise was imposed on tobacco under the Central Excise (Amendment) Act, 2025, while pan masala units got the Health Security se National Security Cess.

nf63e25b94a2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about GST collections in April 2026?
o: Gross collection reached a record ₹2.43 lakh crore
It was the first month gross collection crossed ₹2 lakh crore
nf63e25b94a2.x: Gross GST first crossed ₹2 lakh crore in April 2024; April 2026 set the record of ₹2.43 lakh crore (+8.7%) with net ₹2.11 lakh crore.

n9054c3ee0be.s: Which of the following pairs about GST 2.0 slab shifts (from 22 September 2025) is correctly matched?
n9054c3ee0be.x: About 99% of old 12% items moved to 5%; about 90% of old 28% items moved to 18%, and only the rest to 40%.

n948629fc530.s: Under an Inverted Duty Structure, input tax credit accumulates and blocks working capital because:
o: Tax on output exceeds tax on inputs
Tax paid on inputs exceeds tax payable on output
IGST is not apportioned to States
n948629fc530.x: When the tax on inputs is higher than the tax on output, ITC piles up and blocks the working capital of businesses.

nfdad99eb234.s: States were guaranteed GST compensation at an assured annual growth rate of ____ over the 2015-16 base.
nfdad99eb234.x: Compensation was assured for five years (July 2017 – June 2022) at 14% annual growth over the 2015-16 base.

n9b782b8afd0.s: Which is the second-largest contributor to Andhra Pradesh's own tax revenue (2024-25 RE)?
n9b782b8afd0.x: GST is the largest at about 38% (₹36,296 crore) and State Excise second at about 22% (₹21,300 crore).

new.s: The objective of GST is commonly summed up in the slogan:
new.x: GST replaced a fragmented indirect-tax structure with one tax – 'one nation, one tax'.

new.s: Which was the last State to adopt GST?
new.x: Jammu and Kashmir adopted GST last, on 8 July 2017; Assam was the first to ratify the amendment.

new.s: The GST concept was first used in which country?
new.x: GST was first used in France; India follows the Canadian dual model.

new.s: Who was the first chair of the Empowered Committee of State Finance Ministers on GST?
new.x: Asim Dasgupta first chaired the Empowered Committee, which gave 'A Model and Roadmap for GST' in 2008.

new.s: The GST Council was constituted by the President in:
new.x: The GST Council was formed by the President in September 2016, after the 101st Amendment Act.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Article 246A gives GST law-making power; 269A covers IGST and 279A the GST Council, while 268A (service tax) was omitted.

new.s: By the 101st Constitutional Amendment, Article 268A relating to service tax was:
new.x: The 101st Amendment omitted Article 268A on service tax, since service tax was subsumed in GST.

new.s: In the GST Council, the Union Minister of State in charge of Revenue or Finance is:
new.x: The Union Finance Minister chairs the Council; the MoS in charge of Revenue or Finance is only a member.

new.s: The Vice-Chairperson of the GST Council is chosen by:
o: The State members from among themselves
new.x: The State members of the GST Council choose the Vice-Chairperson from among themselves.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the GST Council?
o: It recommends tax rates, exemptions and threshold limits
It sets up a mechanism to settle Centre-State disputes
Its recommendations bind Parliament and the States
Its proceedings are not invalid because of a vacancy
new.x: In Mohit Minerals (2022) the Council's recommendations were held persuasive, not binding; legislative power stays with Parliament and the States.

new.s: Which of the following was subsumed in GST?
new.x: Entry tax was subsumed in GST; stamp duty, Basic Customs Duty and electricity duty were not.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about taxes and GST:
1. Service tax and CVD on imports were subsumed in GST.
2. State excise on alcoholic liquor was subsumed in GST.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Service tax and CVD were subsumed; State excise on alcoholic liquor was retained outside GST.

new.s: UTGST is levied on intra-UT supplies in:
new.x: UTGST is levied by the Centre for Union Territories without a legislature.

new.s: IGST is levied by the Centre on:
new.x: IGST under Article 269A applies to inter-State supplies and imports, and settles to the consuming State.

new.s: Under the GST Acts, the ceiling rate for IGST is:
new.x: The GST Acts set ceilings of 20% for CGST and 40% for IGST.

new.s: Under GST 2.0, the 40% rate applies to:
new.x: GST 2.0 has 5% for merit goods, 18% standard, and 40% for sin and ultra-luxury (de-merit) goods.

new.s: In December 2022, the work of the National Anti-Profiteering Authority was first transferred to the:
new.x: NAA's work went to the CCI in December 2022, and only from 1 October 2024 to the GSTAT Principal Bench.

new.s: How many digits does a GSTIN have?
new.x: The GSTIN, issued through the GSTN system, is a 15-digit number.

new.s: An e-way bill is generally valid for one day for every:
new.x: An e-way bill, needed for goods above ₹50,000, is valid one day per 200 km.

new.s: Under the GST Compensation Act, any unutilised balance at the end is split between the Centre and the States in the ratio:
new.x: The unutilised balance is split 50:50 – half to the Centre and half shared among the States.

new.s: The GST compensation cess finally ended on:
new.x: Compensation ended in June 2022, cess was scrapped for all but tobacco on 22 Sep 2025, and it ended on 31 March 2026.

new.s: India's record gross GST collection of ₹2.43 lakh crore came in:
new.x: Gross GST hit a record ₹2.43 lakh crore in April 2026.

new.s: In Q1 2026-27, while GST 2.0 cut revenue, the Centre's gross tax grew by only:
new.x: July 2026 GST rose 15.4%, but the Centre's gross tax grew only 3.7% in Q1 2026-27.

new.s: The highest-ever annual gross GST collection, ₹22.27 lakh crore, was recorded in:
new.x: FY 2025-26 recorded the highest-ever ₹22.27 lakh crore (+8.3%); FY 2024-25 was ₹22.08 lakh crore.

new.s: Under GST 2.0, which of the following falls in the 40% demerit slab?
o: Most items of the old 12% slab
new.x: Private aircraft, yachts, ultra-luxury cars, tobacco, pan masala and online gaming are at 40%; gold is 3% and rough diamonds 0.25%.

new.s: The Principal Bench of the GST Appellate Tribunal is located at:
new.x: GSTAT has its Principal Bench in New Delhi, with State benches.

new.s: The GST Appellate Tribunal was launched in September 2025; its hearings began in:
new.x: GSTAT was launched in September 2025 and hearings began in December 2025.

new.s: In Mohit Minerals (2022), the power of Parliament and the States to legislate on GST under Article 246A was held to be:
new.x: The Court held that Parliament and the States have simultaneous power under Article 246A and the Council's recommendations are only persuasive.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about unresolved GST issues?
o: Petroleum and electricity remain outside GST
The date for taxing petroleum is set on Council recommendation under Article 279A(5)
Cesses lie outside the divisible pool
GST Council recommendations are binding on the States
new.x: Mohit Minerals held Council recommendations persuasive, not binding; the other three are correct.

new.s: Which tax is wholly kept by the Union and not shared with the States?
new.x: Surcharge under Article 271 is wholly for the Union; corporation tax and customs are in the shared pool.

new.s: Under Article 268, stamp duties levied by the Union are:
o: Collected and kept by the States
Shared as the Finance Commission recommends
Collected by the Union and assigned to States
new.x: Article 268 duties are levied by the Union but collected and kept by the States.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about taxes:
1. Corporation tax is a Union tax in the shared pool.
2. Agricultural income tax is a Union tax.
3. Entertainment tax is a State tax.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Corporation tax is a Union tax in the shared pool and entertainment tax a State tax; agricultural income tax is a State tax (State List Entry 46).

new.s: The Contingency Fund of India and of the States is provided under Article:
new.x: Article 267 provides for the Contingency Fund; Article 266 covers the Consolidated Fund and Public Account.

new.s: The Consolidated Fund and the Public Account are provided under Article:
new.x: Article 266 deals with the Consolidated Fund and Public Account; 267 is the Contingency Fund.

new.s: Under Article 293(3), a State needs the Centre's consent for fresh loans when:
o: Any Union loan or guarantee is outstanding
It borrows for the first time
new.x: A State needs Centre's consent for fresh loans if any Union loan or guarantee is outstanding, and the Centre may attach conditions under 293(4).

new.s: 'No tax shall be levied except by authority of law' is provided by Article:
new.x: Article 265 says no tax shall be levied except by authority of law.

new.s: Statutory grants-in-aid under Article 275 are charged on the:
new.x: Article 275 grants, recommended by the Finance Commission, are charged on the Consolidated Fund of India; Article 282 grants are voted.

new.s: The divisible pool under Article 270 excludes:
new.x: Cesses and surcharges lie outside the Article 270 divisible pool, so they are not shared with States.

new.s: The Commission on Centre-State relations of 2007-10 was chaired by:
new.x: The Punchhi Commission (2007-10) was chaired by Justice M.M. Punchhi; Sarkaria was 1983-88.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh raises its State Development Loans through the:
new.x: AP raises SDLs through the RBI.
